title: Bayesian Belief Layer for Controllable Opinion Dynamics in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.21997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents in social simulation revise their opinions implicitly, in context: how open an agent is to persuasion can neither be specified nor verified, and collective outcomes inherit the model's training prior. We introduce Bayesian Chronicle Agents (BCA), a minimal belief layer separating \emph{what} an agent believes from \emph{how} it speaks. Each stance is a probability, updated by one Bayesian step per utterance heard. A single prior-strength parameter $\kappa$ encodes stubbornness, modeled after its role in Friedkin--Johnsen (FJ) opinion dynamics. We then sweep this parameter to yield three canonical regimes of opinion dynamics on demand (consensus, persistent disagreement, committed-minority influence), with persistent disagreement matching the FJ closed-form fixed points at $R^2\!=\!0.93$--$0.99$. translated_title: 用于大语言模型智能体中可控观点动力学的贝叶斯信念层
translated_abstract: 社会模拟中的大语言模型智能体在上下文中隐式地修正自身观点：智能体对说服的开放程度既无法被指定也无法被验证，且集体结果会继承模型的训练先验。我们提出了贝叶斯编年史智能体，这是一个将智能体“相信什么”与“如何表达”相分离的最小信念层。每个立场都是一个概率，每听到一次发言就通过一步贝叶斯更新进行更新。单一的先验强度参数 κ 编码了固执程度，其建模方式参照了该参数在 Friedkin–Johnsen (FJ) 观点动力学中的作用。我们随后对该参数进行扫描，可按需产生观点动力学的三种典型模式（共识、持续分歧、坚定少数派影响），其中持续分歧模式与 FJ 闭式不动点相匹配，R² 达到 0.93–0.99。我们进一步表明，预设的 κ 在经过语言往返之后仍然可以被恢复，实现了完美的排序恢复……
tldr: 提出贝叶斯编年史智能体（BCA），通过将“信念”与“表达”分离的贝叶斯信念层，用单一先验强度参数 κ 实现对大语言模型智能体观点动力学的可控调节，可按需产生共识、持续分歧和坚定少数派影响三种典型模式。
en_tdlr: We introduce Bayesian Chronicle Agents (BCA), a minimal Bayesian belief layer that separates what an agent believes from how it speaks, using a single prior-strength parameter κ to achieve controllable opinion dynamics in LLM agents, yielding consensus, persistent disagreement, and committed-minority influence regimes on demand.
